name: police-command
description: POLICE COMMAND — Three.js 3D police operations strategy PWA (Arabic RTL)

paragraphs: Police Command is a 3D police game that runs in the browser. You play a patrol officer in a coastal city, with an Arabic (RTL) interface built mobile-first. It's made with Three.js, TypeScript and Vite, and you can install it as a PWA.
features: Story campaign: 12 missions, plus free patrol with random calls: robberies, gangs, hostages, chases, speeding stops and checkpoint patrols.
The city: downtown, suburbs, a port, and a corniche along the sea. It has textured streets, shops with lit display windows, traffic lights, traffic and pedestrians.
On foot: third-person movement relative to the camera, collision with cars, aim, shoot, "surrender!" orders and handcuffs.

Driving: arcade handling with handbrake drifts and a chase camera that trails at speed. Cars are solid and get shoved, crashes cause damage (the bonnet smokes when it's bad), the siren lights up the light bar and makes…
Character creator: body, skin tone, hair, uniform and weapon, with a live 3D preview.
